subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Segregate
solution: The correct answer is** 'Isolate'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given word** 'segregate '**means to separate one group of people or things from the rest (व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं के एक समूह को दूसरे से अलग करना) • ***Example***: *They **segregate** you from the rest of the community as you are from a different community.* • The marked option 'isolate' means to put or keep somebody/something separate from other people or things. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को अन्‍य व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं से अलग करना या रखना) • From the meanings of these given words, it is clear that 'segregate' and 'isolate' are both synonyms of each other. • Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.​** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • **Submerge**" means to put or sink below the surface of water or some other liquid, or to cover completely. • "**Nullify**" means to cancel or make something legally void or ineffective. • "**Integrate**" means to combine two or more things to form a coherent or unified whole. 3f:T5ce, The correct answer is **'of whom**'.
